title: Lazar told officially he was 'radioactive'

tellings.quote: on an official level, they said, "You know, you're radioactive. We don't want to deal with you."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man known for his claims about secret UFO science, says that at some point officials told him, in effect, "you're radioactive, we don't want to deal with you." He means it as a figure of speech: people in official circles saw him as too dangerous to be linked with because of what he had said publicly.
